summary.intent: Execute Phase 22 (performance baselines completion), clean up the resulting code, populate journey timing baselines against staging, and get PR #355 reviewed and ready to merge.
summary.outcome: Phase 22 fully executed and verified (3/3 plans, 9/9 must-haves), PR #355 created and all 16 review comments resolved across 4 rounds, staging DB reset to fix a vault init bug, journey baselines populated from live staging runs, main merged with conflicts resolved, and BYO-IPFS path instrumented for separate performance visibility.

repo: Phase 22 planning commits were accidentally made directly to main instead of the feature branch; the fix was to create the feature branch at the current HEAD then reset main to origin/main.

Staging DB was never reset after Phase 20 (vault migration) removed encrypted_root_folder_key and encrypted_root_ipns_private_key columns — causing a NOT NULL constraint violation on new wallet logins.
The mock wallet uses EIP-6963 auto-announcement and is injected via Playwright's addInitScript; it cannot be used through the Playwright MCP browser (which lacks addInitScript).
Web3Auth Core Kit MPC init dominates login-to-vault timing at ~23.5s; actual vault load after auth is only ~86ms.
GitHub Actions started requiring manual approval for the lint-pr-title workflow despite it using only shell steps — cause not fully identified, possibly a platform settings change.
Phase 21 added a pinFn BYO-IPFS override to upload/index.ts; Phase 22 added withPerf instrumentation — both needed to be preserved during merge conflict resolution.
Performance instrumentation (withPerf) did not cover the BYO pinFn path, creating a blind spot for clients using their own IPFS nodes.

code.finding: performance.clearMeasures() must be called after getEntriesByName to prevent unbounded PerformanceMeasure accumulation in long-running sessions.
PERF_ENABLED env check needs typeof guard to avoid being true in browser prod where process is polyfilled.
Parallel withPerf calls with the same operation name would collide on mark names — added per-invocation counter suffix to make marks unique.
Axios errors expose HTTP status on error.response.status, not error.status — 404 check was wrong.
expectThresholdsPassed() helper extracted to replace 5 identical 8-line assertion blocks across all load test scenarios; uses throw not vitest expect.
BYO pinFn path now wrapped with withPerf('ipfs:upload:byo') to give separate performance visibility vs CipherBox-pinned uploads ('ipfs:upload').

workflow: The GSD execute-phase workflow correctly skips plans with existing SUMMARY.md files, enabling safe re-runs after partial failures.
CodeRabbit and GitHub Copilot both post automated review threads; multiple rounds of /resolve-pr-comments are needed as reviewers re-comment after each push.
Playwright journey timing tests can target staging by creating a temp config with absolute testDir path and no webServer entries, overriding baseURL.
Staging API logs accessible via SSH show specific DB constraint errors, enabling root-cause diagnosis without frontend debugging.
git diff origin/main..HEAD scoped to non-planning files is the right way to get the code diff for simplify review without planning doc noise.

friction: Phase 22 planning commits were accidentally pushed to main instead of the feature branch, requiring a branch shuffle before execution could start.
Staging DB was never reset after Phase 20 schema changes, causing a NOT NULL vault init crash that blocked all journey timing runs against staging.
Playwright temp config required absolute testDir path — relative paths silently failed with no useful error.
GitHub Actions lint-pr-title workflow suddenly required manual approval with no clear cause, requiring user to manually unblock each CI run.
Usage limits interrupted the session mid-PR-review, requiring a continuation after reset.
CodeRabbit reopened a CAPACITY.md table comment across two review rounds despite it being marked not applicable the first time.
Background task notifications from executor subagents surfaced in the main conversation as stale task-ids, requiring dismissal.
open_items: Journey timing baselines have PENDING markers for share-to-accessible recipient timings — need a second account run to populate.
Two human verification items remain: (1) run journey tests against live services to confirm baselines hold, (2) verify Performance API marks appear in browser DevTools.
GitHub Actions approval requirement for lint-pr-title not fully diagnosed — worth checking Settings > Actions > General fork PR approval settings.
Phase 21 and 23 are still in progress/partially complete — phase ordering was non-sequential (22 before 21).
perf.ts PERF_ENABLED browser dev path still returns false unless __CIPHERBOX_PERF__ is explicitly set — adding it to the web app entrypoint was deferred as out of scope.
